items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: I became General HüBNER personal orchestra leader and played for President (Benish?) up there in Czechoslovakia.

ctx.x: Yes. She was on lend from the British ENSA which is the equivalent of our USO. She was transferred over. They needed piano players who could play accordian and so on and so forth. She could do anything on those things.

So that was it, we got married and went there and came back and then my outfit went all the way up to (Toaz?) in Czechoslovakia and I became General HüBNER personal orchestra leader and played for President (Benish?) up there in Czechoslovakia. And used to fly back and forth to Paris and see Marian and back and forth.
And the General would see that you had a flight, huh? (LAUGHTER).
